should_remesh.tooltip: When set to false, returns an unprocessed triangular mesh.

should_texture.tooltip: Determines whether textures are generated. Setting it to false skips the texture phase and returns a mesh without textures.

enable_pbr.tooltip: Generate PBR Maps (metallic, roughness, normal) in addition to the base color.

texture_prompt.tooltip: Provide a text prompt to guide the texturing process. Maximum 600 characters. Cannot be used at the same time as 'texture_image'.

texture_resolution.tooltip: Base color texture resolution. Higher resolutions capture more surface detail.

texture_image.tooltip: Only one of 'texture_image' or 'texture_prompt' may be used at the same time.

pose_mode.tooltip: Specify the pose mode for the generated model.

ultra_mode.tooltip: Run an extra refinement pass for higher-fidelity geometry with finer surface detail.

ultra_resolution.tooltip: Resolution of the ultra pass: 2k runs it at 2048³, 4k at 4096³ for the finest surface detail. 4k requires meshy-7.1 or latest. Used only when ultra_mode is enabled.
